title: The open unit cube in Euclid (m + 1) has Lebesgue measure 1
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. In ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with its Lebesgue measure (volume), the open unit cube Q₁ := {y : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} has volume 1.
lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} = 1
